Definition: feminine of an adjective of uncertain derivation; Pacatianian, a section of Phrygia:--Pacatiana.
BiblicalUsage: Pacatiana is the name of a district of Phrygia, but the word never occurs in the Greek New Testament as we have it. No verse reads it, so there is no passage to cite and no usage to describe.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that honesty matters more than filling a gap: this name has no verse, so I leave the passage list empty rather than invent one.
